meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 装上并配好 Slack 应用后,助手能在 Slack 的公共/私有频道和私信中收发消息,以机器人身份回复,并用 Slack 的 mrkdwn 语法排版。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入 Slack,或处在 /setup、/init-first-agent、/manage-channels 的频道配置流程中时,按此流程添加 Slack。

say.text: 请帮 NanoClaw 接入 Slack,并让机器人能收发消息。
我用 Socket Mode,不需要公网地址。
say.note: 会引导创建 Slack 应用并粘贴 xapp- Token。

say.text: Slack 应用已建好,帮我校验凭据并重启服务。
say.note: 校验 Token、定位跟机器人的私信,再重启服务。

howto.what_en: Once installed and the Slack app is configured, the assistant can send and receive messages in Slack public/private channels and DMs, reply as the bot, and format messages with Slack mrkdwn.
howto.when_en: Used when the user asks to connect Slack, or while configuring channels via /setup, /init-first-agent, or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Connect NanoClaw to Slack so the bot can send and receive messages.
say_en.note: First picks a delivery mode: Socket Mode or Webhook.

say_en.text: Use Socket Mode; I don't need a public URL.
say_en.note: Walks you through creating the app and pasting the xapp- token.

say_en.text: The Slack app is ready; validate the credentials and restart the service.
say_en.note: Checks tokens, resolves the DM channel, then restarts.
